text:
Sam: Quick check-in on AuroraCompute marketplace + hardware SKU integration for the joint launch. Need clarity on: SKU mapping, SAAS vs HW bundle copy, partner quote, launch timing for press/blog, and analytics hooks. Who's aligned?
Claire: I'll take product copy and the two SKU descriptions (Cloud-only SKU and HW-bundle SKU). I need the Aurora naming conventions and a short tech spec (2 bullets per SKU). @AuroraRep can you provide? :wave: 
AuroraRep: Sharing spec now. Short form:
- "Aurora Basic" = cloud listing only, single-tenant throughput guarantee 50 req/s
- "Aurora Edge Bundle" = includes 1x A100 node managed by partner, pre-configured image
Uploading logos + spec to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/aurora-assets
Vik: On integrations, we'll need a test SKU to validate billing flow and sample provisioning API. Harpreet, can infra mock the provisioning callback?
Harpreet: Yes, will stub a callback endpoint. Need the payload schema from Aurora for node provisioning. Also note: hardware bundle will require an SLA note and a deployment lead time field on the listing.
Claire: Also want two short marketing taglines (<= 60 chars) for each SKU. I'll draft and post by EOD.
Sam: Press timing idea 124-12-05 08:00 PT embargo. Aurora prefers a morning international window. Legal wants 72h pre-clear. Can we meet that?
LegalBot: We'll need partner-signed co-announcement agreement and signoff on the quote wording. I've posted proposed edits: https://docs.redwood.ai/aurora-coannoucement. Please get partner ack by 2024-12-02 09:00 PT to meet 72h rule.
Vik: DocsBot, can you prepare the integration snippet for the partner listing? Example pattern: 
```
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/marketplace/provision', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <TEST_KEY>' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ sku: 'aurora-edge-001', region: 'us-west-2' })
})
```
DocsBot: Snippet added to PR: https://git.redwood.ai/docs/aurora-integration. Also added a checklist for webhooks and status codes.
Harpreet: For QA we need to run provisioning simulation and billing reconciliation. Proposed test matrix: 
- Provision success
- Provision timeout + retry
- Billing invoice creation
I'll spin up test harness on 12/01.
Sam: Tracking/UTM plan suggestion: utm_source=aurora&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=aurora_launch_q4_24. Also add event "marketplace_provision_start" and "marketplace_provision_success" to analytics.
Claire: Design ask: hero image that shows "Managed Edge by Aurora & Redwood" plus two SKU badges. Deliverables in Figma by 11/28.
AuroraRep: Partner quote draft from CPO: "AuroraCompute and Redwood make edge-grade inference easier to deploy and scale." We'll add CEO/CMO versions if needed.
Sam: Action owners: Claire=copy + SKUs + taglines; Vik=integration snippets + infra validation; Harpreet=QA harness + billing tests; LegalBot=co-announcement signoff; DocsBot=docs + sample code; AuroraRep=assets + signed agreement.
Vik: One more detail: SKU IDs must be <= 24 chars, no spaces. I'll enforce that in validation.
AuroraRep: Noted. We'll supply sku ids by 11/26.
Sam: Can everyone confirm ETA for your bits? We want partner assets and signed agreement by 12/02 to hit press 12/05.
Claire: I'll post copy draft 11/29.
Harpreet: QA harness ready 12/01.
Vik: Integration snippet PR by 11/30.
LegalBot: Will re-review on partner upload; will escalate if comments remain after 11/29.
Sam: Great. Scheduling a 20m dry run on 12/04 09:00 PT. If any blockers surface, raise here. Thanks all! :tada:
